name: Manchester Triage System Discriminator Matrix for Telemedicine

RED.description: Immediate life-threatening conditions requiring emergency hospital stabilization.
RED.clinical_action: Proceed to the nearest Emergency Center immediately or dial Nigeria Emergency (112).

YELLOW.description: Potentially serious conditions requiring clinical assessment within 12-24 hours.
YELLOW.clinical_action: Visit a registered Primary Health Care (PHC) center or hospital within 12-24 hours.

GREEN.description: Mild, early, or self-limiting conditions suitable for outpatient dispensary or telemedicine care.
GREEN.clinical_action: Consult a primary healthcare worker or schedule a routine outpatient appointment.

WHITE.description: Minor complaints suitable for home self-care, rest, and hydration.
WHITE.clinical_action: Maintain adequate hydration, get plenty of rest, and monitor symptoms over 48 hours.
